title: PM daily scratchpad - 2026-03-31
content:
Quick log: 2026-03-31

Morning snapshot:
- Feeling behind on the PRD edits — pushed a trimmed version to Confluence, still need to add rollout metrics and rollback criteria.
- 9:00 sync with engineering went long; got alignment on canary gating and telemetry events.
- FYI: SRE capacity numbers changed (Ethan updated infra doc). Need to reconcile for dedicated/hosted numbers in PRD.

Top priorities (today) - ranked:
1) Finalize Smart Batching PRD edits -> include canary criteria, metrics, rollback plan, and SLO impact table. (BLOCKERS: exact SRE throughput numbers; infra team to confirm by EOD)
2) Stakeholder follow-ups: get sign-off from Product Ops and Legal on privacy telemetry for caching keys.
3) Launch checklist prep for Monday internal canary: prepare runbook and incident playbook.

Open questions / outstanding decisions:
- Do we ship the cache-key scrubber in the same deploy as batching (risk: rollout complexity) or as separate follow-up? (Pros/cons discussed in meeting, need product decision)
- Final throughput per-GPU number from infra to put into capacity table (Ethan said he'll confirm 3pm).
- Are we OK with sampling ratio 1:100 for user-level telemetry for the first canary? (Maya to advise re: privacy regs)

PRD edit checklist (what I still need to write or verify):
- [ ] Add canary gating rules (metrics threshold + time window) -> need exact metric names and baseline values from Observability (obs team)
- [ ] Add rollback criteria and automated fallback workflow -> draft in runbook section, expect SRE to validate
- [ ] Update capacity and cost estimates for hosted vs dedicated -> wait on Ethan numbers
- [ ] Add security/privacy notes for prefix caching (Maya to review)
- [ ] Link to eval prompt set and quality regression alerts (upload to Confluence)

Meeting notes (9:00 eng sync):
- Decision: Canary will run in hosted-us-east first; canary% = 1% traffic, gradational steps to 5% over 3 hours if metrics stable.
- Telemetry events: token-latency, tokens-per-request, error-rate-5xx, model-fallbacks, cache-hit-rate. Need exact event names from obs.
- Rollback: automatic if latency > baseline + 25% for 15m OR error-rate > 0.5% for 10m. (Triage playbook to define human steps)
- Action: Ethan -> add throughput numbers to infra doc; Priya -> QA plan and test matrix; Maya -> privacy note for telemetry sampling.

Stakeholder follow-ups to send today:
- Message to product-ops: share draft PRD and ask for rollout window constraints (deadline: 2026-04-02).
- Ping legal (Maya): confirm sampling ratio + retention for caching telemetry.
- Ask observability (Alex R.) for exact metric/event names and dashboard template.

Launch checklist (internal canary) - draft runbook items:
- Pre-canary:
  - Validate deployment artifact sha + config flags (feature flag: smart_batching.v1=true)
  - Smoke test on staging (generate 1000 short requests across models)
  - Baseline metrics capture window (30m) and upload
- During canary:
  - Monitor token-latency, error-rate, cache-hit-rate dashboards (obs-runbook link)
  - Escalation path: on-call SRE -> infra lead -> PM (me) -> Eng triage
  - Communication: #launch channel updates every 15m during ramp
- Post-canary:
  - Post-mortem notes if any deviation; decision to ramp or rollback

Quick TODO (personal):
- [ ] Finish PRD section: "Monitoring & Rollout" (estimate 1.5h)
- [ ] Draft email to legal with sampling rationale (30m)
- [ ] Compile test cases for QA (Priya) and share test matrix (45m)
- [ ] Update Confluence with link to GH PR runtime/pull/1293 and note known caveats (15m)

Notes to self (scratchpad style):
- Keep language in PRD non-technical for exec summary; add a separate technical appendix.
- Remember to call out cost delta for hosted vs dedicated with and without batching (show both per-token and per-inference).
- If we delay cache-key scrubber, add explicit item in backlog and mention privacy risk mitigation.

End-of-day goals:
- PRD ready for review by Product Ops and SRE (aimed at 18:00 PT)
- Legal response queued (Maya) or at least a confirmation of review timeline
- Basic runbook posted and GH PR linked in Confluence

References/links to copy into PRD:
- Confluence: Smart Batching PRD (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/Smart+Batching+PRD)
- JIRA: PRO-4821 (batching rollout epic)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1293

Random notes / mental checklist:
- Keep canary small, measure quality regressions (we should run a tiny eval set each hour during canary)
- Log any user-impacting anomalies immediately in the ticket (PRO-4821)

-- Jordan
